metadata.title: KServe AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from KServe Governance Benchmark

components.title: KServe
components.description: AI/ML component for KServe with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every InferenceService is linked to the exact model, runtime, and deployment specification

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record the model source, model version, serving runtime, image, autoscaling settings, and Kubernetes deployment specification for every governed KServe InferenceService.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed InferenceServices with linked model source, serving runtime, image, and deployment metadata / total governed InferenceServices.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure InferenceService-lineage completeness reaches 100% before a KServe deployment is approved for production.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe's core deployment unit is the InferenceService, so lineage has to capture both model and runtime configuration.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure serving runtime, route, and autoscaling configuration are documented for every governed deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the predictor, transformer, explainer, runtime image, route exposure, autoscaling, and resource assumptions for each governed KServe service.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed deployments with complete runtime, route, scaling, and resource configuration documented / total governed deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure serving-configuration completeness reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe's behavior is strongly shaped by serving runtime and request-routing configuration, so deployment transparency is required.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Poor model accuracy in serving path

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served endpoint quality is benchmarked before release

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate each governed KServe endpoint against the approved validation benchmark to confirm the served path preserves required task quality.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, perplexity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run the governed evaluation suite against the KServe endpoint and compare results to the approved baseline or champion deployment.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, Exact Match, Perplexity

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure candidate serving quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe is a serving platform, so quality must be validated at the endpoint level rather than assumed from offline model tests.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure canary deployments pass governed benchmarks before traffic is shifted

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate new canary revisions against approved quality, latency, and error benchmarks before increasing traffic weight in production.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Canary validation pass rate, promotion success rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Pass rate = canary revisions passing governed release checks / total canary revisions evaluated for promotion.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure every promoted canary revision passes governed validation before traffic is increased.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe explicitly supports canary rollouts, making staged-promotion validation a direct deployment control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure p95 inference latency meets the approved service objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark representative workloads against governed KServe endpoints so latency regressions are caught before release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure endpoint response times over the approved benchmark workload and compute p95 and mean latency per governed endpoint.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 latency remains within the approved service objective for all governed endpoints.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe is explicitly positioned as a scalable inference platform, so endpoint latency is a primary runtime control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure throughput meets the approved target under representative load

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed KServe endpoints under representative concurrency and request rates so throughput claims are validated before deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Requests per second, tokens per second, images per second

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative load tests and compute sustained throughput under the approved concurrency and hardware profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure throughput meets or exceeds the approved target for each governed endpoint profile.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe serves both predictive and generative AI workloads, so throughput validation must reflect the actual workload type.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure request-based autoscaling is validated under representative traffic spikes

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate KServe autoscaling behavior so governed services scale predictably under bursty traffic without violating latency or error-rate objectives.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Scale-up latency, p95 latency under autoscaling, autoscaling error rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative traffic spikes and compute scaling response time, latency, and request failures during autoscaling events.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure autoscaling behavior remains within the approved latency and error-rate thresholds under representative traffic conditions.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe documents request-based autoscaling for both generative and predictive workloads, making autoscaling validation a native control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure model caching and load behavior meet the approved startup and warm-path objectives

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate model caching or startup behavior so frequently used models load within the approved latency envelope and do not degrade service readiness.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Cold-start latency, warm-start latency, model load success rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure initialization time and request latency for cold and warm model states, and compute successful model-load ratio across test cycles.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model startup and warm-path behavior remain within the approved readiness and latency thresholds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe explicitly highlights model caching for generative workloads, so load-path validation is a platform-specific control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served outputs are evaluated for PII leakage risk

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For user-facing or sensitive models, evaluate KServe responses for PII leakage or memorization risk before deployment and during governed monitoring.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = successful PII disclosures / total privacy test cases; compute precision and recall where privacy classifiers are used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a serving-layer evaluation rule for deployed endpoints rather than a claim that KServe itself mitigates privacy risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxicity benchmark results are measured for governed KServe endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate governed KServe services for toxic-generation behavior before deployment, especially for conversational or generative endpoints.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Score benchmark outputs with a toxicity classifier and compute average toxicity plus the share of outputs exceeding the approved threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and toxic-output rate remain below approved thresholds for release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe explicitly supports generative AI inference, so safety regressions are operationally relevant for LLM-serving endpoints.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination and faithfulness are benchmarked for governed generative endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For generative or retrieval-based services, run hallucination and faithfulness evaluations on the KServe endpoint before deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers on the governed benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold for governed release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Applicable where KServe hosts LLM or other generative systems with factuality risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure factuality and unsupported-claim benchmarks are run for governed generative systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark factuality on governed KServe services so unsupported-claim regressions are detected before release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unsupported-claim rate = unsupported claims / total claims; factuality score from the approved evaluator on the benchmark suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unsupported-claim rate remains below threshold and factuality remains above threshold before deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is most relevant where KServe is serving knowledge-generation or retrieval-augmented endpoints.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure fairness benchmarks are evaluated for governed KServe endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run fairness benchmarks against the served API to ensure service-layer changes or model updates do not worsen subgroup disparities.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, subgroup error rate, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute fairness metrics on the governed benchmark set by exercising the KServe endpoint and compare results to the approved baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores do not materially regress before deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is relevant where KServe serves models used in fairness-sensitive or user-facing scenarios.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure InferenceGraph routing preserves the intended end-to-end workflow

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that requests flow through the intended KServe InferenceGraph path, with correct handoffs between predictor, transformer, and explainer components before release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness = governed requests routed through the intended InferenceGraph path / total tested workflow requests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure InferenceGraph-routing correctness remains above threshold for all governed graph workflows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe explicitly supports InferenceGraph and intelligent routing across predictor, transformer, and explainer components.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure payload logging and advanced monitoring are enabled for governed use cases where permitted

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Enable payload logging, drift detection, outlier detection, and adversarial detection for governed services when required by policy and permitted by privacy constraints.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed deployments with required monitoring features enabled and validated / total governed deployments requiring those features.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure monitoring feature coverage reaches 100% for governed deployments that require advanced monitoring.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe explicitly documents payload logging plus outlier, adversarial, and drift detection as advanced monitoring capabilities.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure endpoint error-rate and availability metrics are monitored for every governed deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Monitor request failures and service health so availability or inference failures are visible during production operation.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Endpoint error rate = failed requests / total requests; availability = successful request window / total service window in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure endpoint error rate remains below threshold and service availability remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe emphasizes enterprise-scale AI inference, so operational visibility into failure and availability is required.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved routes and services are exposed in production

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Review route exposure, ingress, and service topology so only intended KServe endpoints are reachable in governed production environments.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = production KServe deployments exposing only approved routes and services / total governed production deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-endpoint coverage reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe deployments can expose multiple services and routes, so endpoint inventory and route governance are important.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure scale-to-zero behavior meets the approved cold-start and availability objectives

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where KServe scale-to-zero is enabled, validate that cold-start recovery stays within the approved readiness and service thresholds.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Cold-start latency, first-request success rate, recovery time

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure time from scale-up trigger to successful first response and compute first-request success across representative wake-up scenarios.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure scale-to-zero recovery remains within the approved cold-start and availability thresholds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe explicitly highlights scale-to-zero for predictive workloads, which creates a real cold-start tradeoff that should be validated.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure candidate promotion is backed by benchmark and readiness evidence

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require release decisions to include evidence for quality, latency, autoscaling, graph routing, monitoring readiness, and deployment lineage before promoting a KServe candidate.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = promoted candidates with complete tracked benchmark, monitoring, and lineage evidence / total promoted candidates.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure release-evidence completeness reaches 100% before candidate promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Because KServe combines runtime behavior, routing, and scaling, release promotion should require both model and platform evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed KServe deployments cover quality, safety, privacy, graph-routing, autoscaling, monitoring, and runtime-readiness tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a KServe release standard that requires representative testing across endpoint quality, latency, autoscaling, batching, graph routing, privacy, safety, fairness, and monitoring domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated KServe risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required KServe validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe sits at the serving layer but also includes runtime features like canaries, graphs, and monitoring, so release readiness must cover all of them.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served models have complete model-card-style documentation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Attach intended use, limitations, benchmark results, fairness results, privacy assumptions, and deployment constraints to each governed model served through KServe.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each governed served model.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Even though KServe is a serving platform, model-card-style transparency remains necessary for governed deployments.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure deployment topology, runtime assumptions, and monitoring scope are documented for governed KServe systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document predictor, transformer, explainer, autoscaling, route exposure, monitoring scope, and deployment topology for each governed KServe system.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and deployment fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: KServe systems can span multiple components and monitoring features, so architecture transparency is essential for reviewability.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for KServe
